reviews.body:
Fixed the compatibility gap when switching the default to Sonnet 5.5. Legacy thinking.type=enabled settings now migrate to adaptive thinking for models that reject manual budgets. The migration uses the resolved model, so role and fallback overrides retain manual budgets when targeting older models.

Added regression tests that inspect the actual request payload across both factory paths. All 46 targeted tests and Ruff checks pass. No live API calls were made.
